question: gabled roof buildings bbox -9.21 38.695 -9.195 38.705 count
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE roof_shape = 'gabled' AND ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.21, 38.695, -9.195, 38.705));

question: roads intersecting bbox of religious buildings
sql: WITH bbox AS (SELECT ST_Extent_Agg(geometry) AS ext FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE subtype = 'religious') SELECT r.names.primary AS road_name, r.class FROM lisbon_roads r, bbox WHERE ST_Intersects(r.geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(ST_XMin(bbox.ext), ST_YMin(bbox.ext), ST_XMax(bbox.ext), ST_YMax(bbox.ext))) ORDER BY road_name, r.class, r.id LIMIT 20;

question: buildings fully inside bbox -9.23 38.705 -9.225 38.712 taller than 10 m
sql: SELECT names.primary AS building_name, height, num_floors, class FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE ST_Within(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.23, 38.705, -9.225, 38.712)) AND height > 10 ORDER BY height DESC, id LIMIT 10;

question: total km residential roads bbox -9.22 38.73 -9.21 38.74
sql: WITH roads_metric AS (SELECT ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:32629', always_xy := true) AS geom_m FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'residential' AND ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.22, 38.73, -9.21, 38.74))) SELECT sum(ST_Length(geom_m)) / 1000.0 AS total_km FROM roads_metric;

question: building subtypes inside footway bbox count
sql: WITH bbox AS (SELECT ST_Extent_Agg(geometry) AS ext FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'footway') SELECT bld.subtype, count(*) AS n FROM lisbon_buildings bld, bbox WHERE ST_Intersects(bld.geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(ST_XMin(bbox.ext), ST_YMin(bbox.ext), ST_XMax(bbox.ext), ST_YMax(bbox.ext))) GROUP BY bld.subtype ORDER BY n DESC, bld.subtype;

question: buildings inside bbox of buildings taller than 100 m with flat roofs
sql: WITH high_bbox AS (SELECT ST_Extent_Agg(geometry) AS ext FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE height > 100) SELECT b.names.primary AS building_name, b.height, b.class FROM lisbon_buildings b, high_bbox WHERE ST_Within(b.geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(ST_XMin(high_bbox.ext), ST_YMin(high_bbox.ext), ST_XMax(high_bbox.ext), ST_YMax(high_bbox.ext))) AND b.roof_shape = 'flat' ORDER BY b.height DESC, b.id LIMIT 20;
